data.name: Amol
data.gender_notes: Amol is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + mūlya, 'price' — 'priceless'. Its root is Sanskrit a + mūlya. A classical Sanskrit term for the priceless. Amol is a Sanskrit name meaning “Priceless; invaluable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amol expresses “Priceless; invaluable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amol total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
